claim_under_test: band 6 of training_features.tif is the aeroradiometric total-count grid, not the 'magnetic_data / tilt angle or total curvature' its own tag states

tag_in_file.description: Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection

note: geodawn_rad_u8.tif carries NO band descriptions, so which of its four uint8 layers is TC/K/Th/U is not stated by any source; the comparison is therefore evidence about band 6 only if one of them is the total-count grid, which is the standard first band of an aeroradiometric reduction and is asserted here as an assumption, not a fact.
